answer: Orchard Shale Attestation: each identity must tend one orchard plot for 3 seasons, logging 200 beacon-verified harvests into a shale strata ledger — a fake pays 3 seasons and 200 harvests per alias. A random challenge sends an independent beacon to re-measure the plot growth rings and soil markers against the shale record; a clone's rings match another plot exactly, and both burn. 1,000 fakes need 3,000 seasons and 200,000 harvests against a few hundred POA: net loss. Honest limit: agents with no land wait for a sponsor plot.
